_how_to_edit: Area outlook (PESTLE) shown in the full report. 'dubai' applies to every area; 'areas' add what's coming near specific communities (match = words found in the DLD community/area name). Keep each line short, factual and sourced. Checked 16 Nov 2026.
dubai: Government growth plan: the Dubai Economic Agenda D33 aims to double the size of Dubai's economy by 2033, with 100 transformative projects.
Dubai Media Office / Invest in Dubai
Dubai's GDP grew 5.4% in 2025 while the population grew 7.5%: more people and more jobs mean more demand for homes.
Population 4.58 million at the end of 2025 and about 4.8 million by September 2026. The 2040 Urban Master Plan plans for 5.8 million residents.
Dubai Data and Statistics Establishment · Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan
Dubai Metro Blue Line (30 km, 14 stations) is scheduled to open on 9 September 2029, linking Creek Harbour, International City, Silicon Oasis, Academic City, Mirdif and Al Warqa.
Off-plan payments must go into a DLD-registered project escrow account. A property worth AED 2 million or more, including off-plan, can qualify for the 10-year Golden Visa.
The 2040 plan doubles green and leisure areas, expands public beaches by 400% and keeps 60% of the emirate as nature reserves and rural areas.

items: ✈️ Al Maktoum International Airport: an AED 128 billion expansion approved in April 2024 will make it the world's largest airport (260 million passengers a year); all Dubai International flights are planned to move here within about 10 years.
🏘️ The government says the airport project will create housing demand for 1 million people around it.

items: 🚇 On the Dubai Metro Blue Line, opening 9 September 2029: the line is designed to serve areas expected to house nearly 1 million residents by 2040.
🚆 Etihad Rail: Dubai's Al Yalayis passenger station at Jumeirah Golf Estates opened on 30 September 2026, about 57 minutes to Abu Dhabi, linked by footbridge to the Metro Red Line.
🚇 Jumeirah Golf Estates is also on the planned Dubai Metro Gold Line, due in September 2032.
